name: BlobCursor-TS-TW
title: Blob Cursor
blurb: Custom cursor appears as a smooth blob following pointer movement.
description: Renders a blob-shaped cursor with trail effect and customizable colors. Uses SVG filters for visual effects and GSAP for smooth animation. Replaces the default cursor.
use_when: Premium interactive sites, creative portfolios, or branding-focused UI.
avoid_when: Accessibility-focused designs; custom cursor can conflict with user preferences.
a11y: Custom cursor may conflict with prefers-cursor setting. No aria attributes.
